name: Irrigation water per yield
description: Litres of irrigation water applied per kilogram of yield produced. Lower values indicate more water-efficient production.
notes: Numerator and denominator must cover the same period and site. Aggregation is performed by summing both numerator and denominator across the matched period set, then taking the ratio of the totals.

name: Irrigation intensity
description: Average irrigation applied per square metre per day. Useful as a coarse hydrological footprint indicator.

name: Energy per yield
description: Kilowatt-hours of electricity consumed per kilogram of yield.

name: Yield per area
description: Total yield mass per square metre of cultivated area.

name: Nitrogen input per yield
description: Mass of nitrogen applied per kilogram of yield. Used as a proxy for nutrient efficiency.
notes: Only tracks nitrogen. Future LIFE work packages may add phosphorus, potassium and micronutrient KPIs; the framework does not invent them.

name: Labour per yield
description: Person-hours of labour invested per kilogram of yield produced.

name: Labour intensity per area
description: Person-hours of labour invested per square metre of cultivated area.

name: Sensor / data uptime
description: Fraction of expected sensor samples successfully captured and ingested. 1.0 means no missing data.

name: Anomaly detection-to-response time
description: Median time between an anomaly being detected and a human/automated response being recorded, in minutes.
notes: Computed only when both detection_time and response_time are present. If either is missing the KPI is reported as missing_input.

name: AI recommendation acceptance rate
description: Share of model-issued recommendations accepted by the operator. A proxy for trust calibration, not for model quality.

name: AI recommendation outcome match
description: Share of accepted recommendations whose actual outcome matched the model prediction. Used as a precision proxy, not a true precision metric.
